_comment: Per-rule ceiling for `ruff --select F` over app/, enforced by
scripts/check_ruff_gate.py in deploy.yml. A count may FALL, never rise.
Fix findings and ratchet the number down in the same change; do not raise a
number to make a build pass. Same contract as the platform repo's
.github/edge-typecheck-baseline.json.
NOT listed here — enforced at ZERO by ZERO_TOLERANCE in the gate script:
F821 undefined name       41 -> 0
F811 redefinition         10 -> 0
F401 unused import       371 -> 0
F541 f-string no fields  139 -> 0
invalid-syntax             1 -> 0
What is left, and why it is still a ratchet rather than a gate:
F841 (46) unused local. Ruff cannot fix these safely: the pattern is
`result = something()` where the call has side effects and only the
binding is dead, so removing the statement would remove the call. Each
needs a human to decide whether the ignored result should have been
checked. Triaged once already for security-shaped cases (a computed
workspace_id in validate-pipeline is genuinely unused; that route gates on
verify_internal_access and scopes by document_id from the job row).
F405 (22) / F403 (5) star imports. Fixing means enumerating what each
`from x import *` actually provides. Mechanical but not automatic, and a
wrong enumeration is an ImportError.
